text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as summer training camp began— news 
arrived that Almond Eye was slated to run 
in the Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Looking ahead to the autumn Grand Prix, 
the Arima Kinen, the results of the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn) hold great significance...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"That might very well be what has the 
biggest impact on the fan vote results..."
choice_data_list:
We have to figure out a way to beat Almond 
Eye no matter what.

We have to figure out a way to beat Almond 
Eye no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm still... not digging in enough...! I 
must be subconsciously trying to conserve 
my stamina...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I have to squeeze out every last drop...! 
And build the strength to see it through 
to the end...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Otherwise, I can't win...! Because I am! 
Definitely going to win!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a terrifyingly fierce tenacity. It 
screamed of victory, even if it meant 
pushing past her limits.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The defeat in her last race... That must 
be what lit a fire under Ai-san...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
choice_data_list: Let's train so you can surpass that!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! I'll be in your care...!
